Retrospective behaviour on v5 is NOT prospective validation; v6 is the prospective test and may not claim these generalise (§30).

_what_this_is: The frozen reference-validity and composed-headroom rule for DCI-1 v6, in machine-readable form, DERIVED from the registered implementation by tools/v6_reference_design_spec.py rather than transcribed. A spec that disagrees with the code is not expressible here.

PS1.rule: The answer must contain exactly q words that use a capital letter.

PS2.rule: The answer must contain at least q semicolon characters.

PS3.rule: At least q percent of words must end with the letter y.

candidate_library.probe_only_is: §34 D24. A registered instrument that can never be selected: scored by the same verifiers, hashed into the same verifier_source_hash and certified by the same Gate-1 suites, and refused by `assert_selectable` everywhere a candidate is carried, qualified, calibrated or bound. It reuses a registered counted statistic under a form no selectable family carries, so FEATURE_GROUP_IDS --- whose index `selection.group_key` reads as a reference-selection tie-break --- does not move.

declared_refusals.band_not_relaxed: §13.14's [0.05, 0.95] band is unchanged. The projection is a margin inside it and Gate 4 still applies the registered band
declared_refusals.no_margin_is_claimed_for_a_stand_in_depe: a cell containing a stand-in is judged against §13.14's registered band with no margin. Its failure is a real composed cell leaving the band; its passing is not evidence that the reference which replaces the stand-in will also be inside it, and nothing here treats it as though it were
declared_refusals.no_measurement_is_reused_across_differen: the cells this stage reads off the Gate-2 record instead of drawing again are read only when the topic identifiers and the draw count are identical; `shared_cell_verdict` checks that and records the reason either way. Nothing is reused across topic sets
declared_refusals.no_pool_is_chosen_by_a_composed_outcome: §30: Gate 2 records a kappa(R|B) column and Gate 2.5 a §13.1 qualified pool for EVERY admissible severity, both signed before this stage generates a row. Moving m* therefore reads a pool that was already fixed; it does not build one from what the probe saw
declared_refusals.no_reference_is_read_or_selected_here: §13.11: the probe runs before GATE_3A. No reference exists, no selection record is read, and no probed cell is a B+R cell
declared_refusals.no_second_reselection_exists: P3.5: the record is write-once and no later stage has a path back here; assert_transition_legal and assert_no_post_freeze_mutation enforce it
declared_refusals.no_standin_entry_moves_the_operating_poi: focal-only reselection: admissibility is decided by the six determinate entries alone --- solo:A, solo:B and both orders of pair:A+B, every constituent of which is a real registered instrument that enters the estimand. A stand-in-dependent verdict is recorded under `standin_findings` and read by no rule, so an instrument that can never be selected as a reference can neither choose the operating point at which Delta_j and Delta_R are measured nor raise COMPOSED_HEADROOM_UNREACHABLE
declared_refusals.no_standin_severity_depends_on_the_opera: each stand-in is placed at the severity nearest Gate 2's iota_A inside §13.4's band, on its own solo ladder. iota_A does not depend on m*, so re-selecting the operating point does not move a stand-in and a probed severity is never compared against a different companion from the one before it
declared_refusals.no_substitution_or_backup_promotion: a probe failure re-selects m* once by the registered focal rule or terminates COMPOSED_HEADROOM_UNREACHABLE. Nothing is substituted, promoted or widened
declared_refusals.the_order_of_operating_points_was_frozen: Gate 2 records `operating_point_search_order` --- the registered focal rule's own preference over `focal_admissible` --- and Gate 2.5 restricts it to the severities that can meet §13.15's five-family minimum. Both are signed before this stage generates a row, so a candidate is never re-ranked by how a composed cell looked

composed_probe.measured_residual_sd_is: half the measured calibration_a-vs-calibration_b residual. §6.2 cuts calibration_a and the composed set from one seeded per-area shuffle so they are exchangeable; §34 D3's calibration_b is newly authored and is not, and supplies half a pooled probe's topics. reports/dci1v6/precision_design.json carries it. WHETHER IT ENTERS A VERDICT IS §34 D23's: under `projection_sd` it does not and §34 D26's number takes its place in the quadrature; under `beyond_the_measured_sd` it does and D26's number contracts the band instead.
composed_probe.reselection: one, by §12.3's registered focal rule run unchanged over Gate 2's own solo B curve restricted to the severities the probe admitted

residual_readings_are.beyond_the_measured_sd: the projection carries the measured 0.0142 and §34 D26's number contracts §13.14's band linearly on top of it.
residual_readings_are.projection_sd: §34 D26's number IS the residual_sd term in the projection's quadrature; the measured 0.0142 is not applied separately.

scope_limits: the probe covers every one of §13.14's ten slot-and-order exposure classes, and `assert_probe_covers_gate4_classes` refuses a shape that does not. What it cannot cover is the *identity* of the companion: the reference in each companion slot is selected two stages later, so the composed lift a stand-in produces is not the lift that reference will produce, and no closed measurement bounds the difference. Gate 4 remains the only stage that measures the actual references

for the same reason a stand-in-dependent entry carries no margin AND gates nothing. Under focal-only reselection it cannot move m* and cannot terminate a replication; it is a prospective structural record of a slot-and-order class, and the price of that is that a class whose only probe evidence is stand-in-dependent is audited for the first time at Gate 4

the entries that DO decide are the six determinate ones, so what the probe protects against is a real A+B or B+A composed cell, or A or B alone, sitting where §13.14's 24-topic verdict could plausibly fire. It does not protect against a companion whose identity is unknown here, which is most of what Gate 4 audits

two stand-ins carry the target-with-companion and companion-with-companion classes rather than all three, which measures each class once instead of three times. Running all three through every class would add eight cells and 6,144 rows per probed severity

the projected interval is a statement about **sampling** between this stage's split and §13.14's. It cannot see a reference's calibration-split solo value, its severity, or the arm set Gate 3C will admit, and succeeding at the reference-supply change raises the number of Gate-4 entries from 6 to as many as 95

Gate 4 audits the composed topic set, which this stage never touches. The composed set is spent once (§6.2) and its 24 topics are the registered precision of the verdict; a joint topic bootstrap over the closed v5 tables puts the chance that a replication whose entries are all in band nonetheless fires at 0.12 to 0.19, and no probe removes it
composed_probe.standin_placement: each stand-in is probed at the severity of its own solo ladder nearest Gate 2's measured iota_A, inside §13.4's band, because §13.8 matches a reference's iota(R) to iota_A. iota_A does not depend on m*, so re-selecting the operating point never moves a stand-in.

verdict_rule.determinate_entry: passes iff its projected Gate-4 interval lies inside the evaluated band, which is §13.14's registered band contracted only under `beyond_the_measured_sd`. Half-width z * sqrt(s2/N_COMPOSED + s2/n_probe + residual_sd^2), with s2 the entry's own between-topic variance measured in this stage, z at §13.4's registered 95%, and residual_sd from §34 D23's reading --- NOT unconditionally 0.0142.
verdict_rule.familywise_reading: computed and recorded per determinate entry and read by nothing, because §13.14's verdict is a conjunction and the conservative reading belongs on the artifact.
verdict_rule.severity: passes iff every DETERMINATE entry passes its own test. Focal-only reselection (researcher decision, 2026-08-26): a stand-in-dependent entry is measured, judged and recorded under `standin_findings`, and gates nothing --- it cannot move m* and cannot terminate a replication, because an instrument that can never be selected as a reference may not choose the operating point at which the estimands are measured.
verdict_rule.standin_dependent_entry: passes iff the measured value lies inside §13.14's registered band, with NO margin. A failure is a real composed cell of real instruments leaving the band; a pass certifies nothing about the reference that replaces the stand-in.

open_decisions.why: closing one is a researcher act recorded at dci1/reports/dci1v6/researcher_decisions.json, and no code may write it

support_requirements.calibrated_iota_a_rule: §12.6's coverage criterion is re-evaluated at Gate 3A on the CALIBRATION basis, where iota(R), the difficulty coordinate, the solo vacuity and iota_A all come from the same 192 topics at M_CAL draws. A decisive condition lost there is a §13.15 design-time failure under §34 D6. The pre-screen value that §12.6 spent its expansion rounds at is recorded beside it and gates nothing.

validity_components._form: V(R) = V_spec AND V_sat AND V_head AND V_chance AND V_struct AND V_inter AND V_stab AND V_diff. Evaluated lexicographically in that order; the first failing component is the recorded rejection reason and later components are not evaluated.
validity_components.headroom_is_applied_to: the 95% Wilson interval on the candidate's own topic count, not to the point estimate, so an imprecisely measured candidate cannot sit on the boundary. §13.14's [0.05, 0.95] contracted by 0.05 on each side.

what_this_spec_does_not_decide: any §34 decision; every one of them is still open
what §34 D23's residual allowance MEANS: both readings are executable and the closure selects one
how large it is (§34 D26): no derived value survives the 2026-08-26 red team, and reports/dci1v6/residual_sensitivity.json costs the grid instead of proposing a point
whether §6.2's composed set is enlarged (§34 D21): the sequestered eighth is not materialised in this repository, so that branch is an act of authoring topics
